title: 第4章 请神第5章 羽书第6章 自由
content_zh:
看着掌心位置的变化，张羽忍不住想到“这到底是什么意思？”
“不会填满以后我就挂了吧？”
可惜无人能够解答张羽此刻心中的不安。
结束了上午的体育课后，张羽便拖着半死不活的身体和白真真、周天翊一起吃了午饭，然后稍稍休息片刻就又迎来了下午的课程。
下午第一节课是历史课，讲课的老师是一名满头白发的老者。
老者进入教室后便自顾自坐到了讲台后，翻开书本便随意的讲解了起来。
至于台下的学生们是在抓紧时间休息，吐纳，修炼，甚至离开教室去炼体，他似乎都没有在意。
张羽也没兴趣听这位历史老师讲课的内容，他只是快速翻看着课本，脑海中便不断回想起了其中的内容，并结合自己本身的记忆进行了理解。
“昆墟没有国家，一切都由十大宗门垄断并掌握。昆墟在地面上有三十六层，第一层大概有两个中国这么大，由各个大小不一的城市组成，每个城市有大宗门搭建的市政府进行管理。”
“第一层的世界抛开仙道相关之外，科技水平似乎和我上辈子差不多，但老百姓的日子好像要辛苦多了。”
“昆墟第一层也是张羽一直以来生活的地方，至于再往上……那他就只有在电视电影里见过了。”
根据张羽记忆中所了解，只有考上大学才能进入昆墟第二层，而只有大学毕业并加入大宗门，那才能上到更高层。
可以说在这昆墟之中，只有掌握更强的仙道力量，更高的权限，才能一步步向上爬。
而越是上层，传说中灵气更为充沛，仙道技术更为发达，各种物资也越发富足。
回想到这里的时候，张羽忍不住回头看向窗外，感受着那漫天洒下的阳光。
“如此真实的天空和阳光……这里真的是在某座超巨型建筑里吗？”
“第一层就有两个中国大小，那整个昆墟要占多大空间？肯定已经不在地球上了吧？”
“我究竟又是怎么来到这个世界的？”
他脑海中不知不觉回想起了刚刚来到这个世界的景象，想起了那诡异仪式，然后脑袋就又感觉到了一阵眩晕。
张羽赶紧摇了摇头，对于此刻的他来说，相比起这些大事，还是高中成绩、生活费、赚钱、体育课……这些眼前的事情更需要他的关注。

而想起成绩和修炼，张羽就又是一阵头疼。
除了上午的体育课之外，仙道成绩中还分别有道心、法力、武功、道术这四科。
其中道心占150分，法力占150分，武功100分，道术100分。
而按照张羽心中的记忆来看，最近他的成绩排名已经是全方位下滑，就没一科不是在退步的。
照这样下去，似乎最后被嵩阳高中退学也只是时间问题。
而张羽心中又冒出了另一个疑问。
“现在看来，张羽家里既不有钱，他自己也没有什么出众的仙道天赋，不论是第一年还是第二年的面试好像都不太成功，他到底是怎么进嵩阳高中的？”
张羽反复回忆，只记得原身就是顶着不太理想的面试结果进入了嵩阳高中。
而想到原身的家庭，他目光微微一动，掏出手机打开了通讯录。
“对了，放学后要不要联系一下张羽的爸妈还有姐姐？”
下午的课程中，张羽便在一边复习，一边整理脑海中的记忆中渡过，这让他对于脑海中的知识，对于这个世界，对于张羽的身份，都了解得越来越深。
转眼间时间来到了六点放学的时候。
学校今天的课程已经全部结束，但对绝大部分嵩阳高中的学生们来说，一天课程只过了一半，接下来他们还需要参加各自的补习，然后自习到后半夜才能休息。
而和急匆匆赶往各自补习班的同学们不同，张羽此刻正坐在空荡荡的食堂里。
没有了存款和借贷额度的他从两周前开始就没上补习班了。
于是在吃完了晚饭之后，他思量一番，还是打开了手机。
“试试看吧。”
先是打给了张羽的母亲，接着又打给了父亲，却全都是无人接听的状态。
回忆着脑海中张羽父母、姐姐的相关记忆，他最终还是无奈地打给了姐姐。
“张羽？”

听着手机另一头那略显冰冷的声音，张羽硬着头皮说道“姐，能不能借我点钱？”
一阵沉默中，就在张羽以为对方会挂了电话的时候，从手机中传来声音“你小学一年级的时候，我就和爸妈说了，你没有仙道天赋，往这条路上走完全是浪费时间和钱。”
“分开后，老妈却相信了你的妄想，硬着头皮想要一个人供你上高中，甚至她前不久还找我们来借钱，想要动我的补课费。”
content_en:
Seeing the change in the position of his palm, Zhang Yu couldn't help but think, "What does this mean?"
"I won't die after it's full, right?"
It's a pity that no one can answer the uneasiness in Zhang Yu's heart at this moment.
After finishing the morning physical education class, Zhang Yu dragged his half-dead body to have lunch with Bai Zhenzhen and Zhou Tianyi, and then took a short rest before heading to the afternoon class again.
The first class in the afternoon was a history class, and the teacher was an old man with white hair.
After the old man entered the classroom, he sat behind the podium, opened the book and started explaining casually.
As for the students in the audience taking the time to rest, breathe, practice, or even leave the classroom to practice, he didn't seem to care.
Zhang Yu was not interested in listening to the history teacher's lecture. He just flipped through the textbook quickly, constantly recalling the content in his mind, and combined it with his own memory to understand it.
"Kunxu has no country. Everything is monopolized and controlled by the ten major sects. Kunxu has thirty-six floors on the ground. The first floor is about the size of two Chinas. It is composed of cities of different sizes. Each city is managed by a municipal government built by a large number of sects."
"Except for the immortal world, the technological level of the world on the first level seems to be similar to that of my previous life, but the lives of ordinary people seem to be much harder."
"The first floor of Kunxu is where Zhang Yu has always lived. As for the floors above... he has only seen it in TV movies."
According to Zhang Yu's memory, only by going to university can one enter the second level of Kunxu, and only by graduating from university and joining a large sect can one go to a higher level.
It can be said that in this Kunxu, only by mastering stronger immortal power and higher authority can one climb up step by step.
The higher the level, the more spiritual energy is said to be abundant, the immortal technology is more developed, and all kinds of materials are more abundant.
When thinking about this, Zhang Yu couldn't help but look back out the window and feel the sunshine shining all over the sky.
"Such a real sky and sunshine...Is this really a giant building?"
"The first floor is the size of two Chinas. How much space does the entire Kunxu occupy? It must no longer be on earth, right?"
"How on earth did I come into this world?"
In his mind, he unknowingly recalled the scene when he first came to this world and the strange ritual, and then he felt dizzy again.
Zhang Yu quickly shook his head. For him at this moment, compared to these big things, high school grades, living expenses, making money, physical education classes...these things in front of him needed his attention more.
Thinking of his grades and training, Zhang Yu had another headache.
In addition to the physical education class in the morning, the Immortal Path exams also include four subjects: Taoist Heart, Magical Power, Martial Arts, and Taoism.
Among them, Taoist heart accounts for 150 points, magic power accounts for 150 points, martial arts accounts for 100 points, and Taoism accounts for 100 points.
According to Zhang Yu's memory, his performance ranking has been declining in all aspects recently, and there is no subject that is not declining.
At this rate, it seems that it will only be a matter of time before he is eventually dropped out of Songyang High School.
And another question popped up in Zhang Yu's mind.
"Now it seems that Zhang Yu's family has no money, and he himself has no outstanding talent for immortality. Whether it is the first or second year interview, it seems that the interview was not very successful. How did he enter Songyang High School?"
Zhang Yu recalled it repeatedly, only remembering that he entered Songyang High School despite unsatisfactory interview results.
Thinking of his original family, his eyes moved slightly, and he took out his mobile phone and opened his address book.
"By the way, do you want to contact Zhang Yu's parents and sister after school?"
During the afternoon class, Zhang Yu spent time reviewing and sorting out the memories in his mind. This made him understand the knowledge in his mind, the world, andZhang Yu's identity is becoming more and more understood.
In a blink of an eye, it was time to get out of school at six o'clock.
The school's classes have all ended today, but for most students of Songyang High School, the day's classes are only halfway through. Next, they still need to participate in their own tutoring, and then study by themselves until midnight before resting.
Unlike his classmates who were rushing to their respective cram schools, Zhang Yu was sitting in the empty cafeteria at the moment.
With no savings and loan limit, he has not attended cram school since two weeks ago.
So after finishing dinner, he thought about it and turned on his phone.
"Just give it a try."
First he called Zhang Yu's mother, and then he called his father, but no one answered the call.
Recalling the memories of Zhang Yu's parents and sister in his mind, he finally called his sister helplessly.
"Zhang Yu?"
Listening to the slightly cold voice on the other end of the phone, Zhang Yu said bravely, "Sister, can you lend me some money?"
There was a moment of silence, and just when Zhang Yu thought the other party would hang up, a voice came from the mobile phone: "When you were in the first grade of elementary school, I told my parents that you have no talent for immortality, and it is a complete waste of time and money to go down this path."
"After we separated, my mother believed your delusions and decided to support you in high school by herself. She even asked us to borrow money not long ago and wanted to use my tuition fee."
